scope: Navigation and proposed verification routing only. This crosswalk makes no implementation, G acceptance, or new finding-closure decision.

priority_key.P0_G27_01_source_blocker: G27-01 on V6/B13, with Q2 cross-cutting identity. Demonstrate actual intended profile-conflict red after valid A/A fixture, then fix and replay.
priority_key.P1_explicit_G27_followup: Existing G27 follow-up or accurate accepted-property provenance; inspect item before scheduling. Does not imply a new finding closure.
priority_key.P2_specialist_or_shared_row: Reconcile all assigned specialist rows and original occurrence predicate; dependencies and shared owners decide exact ordering.
priority_key.P3_Q0_occurrence_refresh: Run occurrence-specific existing Q0 nextcheck only after evidence/source/input/consumer rebind.
priority_key.preserve_historical_B198_no_reopen: Keep the historical B198 closed decision intact. Source-only Q0 nextcheck is a locator, not an instruction to reopen B198.
priority_key.P2_targeted_Q0_rebind: Selected LA-029, B199 and LA-004 occurrence-specific rebinds; preserve their exact historical status and original criterion.

reading_rules: Fragment-only pointers are relative to the corresponding named source: coverage_pointer -> coverage; q0_source_only_nextcheck_pointer -> q0_synthesis_source_only; specialist_detail_hints/detail_remaining_pointer -> detail_assessed_at_a92; canonical_task_pointer -> task_manifest; handover_binding_pointer -> handover_bindings.

canonical_task_rows are the manifest IDs at finding level: for repeated IDs they are candidate routes for each card, not independently proven occurrence ownership. The source block and bundle define each occurrence obligation.

A Q0 source-only nextcheck is a design locator, not observed runtime success and not G approval. A specialist_detail_hint is textual navigation only; if absent the whole row still applies and an exact check must be derived from the original criterion.
G task_routes are supplemental oversight and dependency links, not added canonical task-finding edges. G27-07 composition is cross-cutting.
Historical statuses are frozen source records; current slice adds no formal finding closures. No acceptance is inferred from cards, path existence, or reports alone.

q0_underlying_source_report selects the hashed family report and exact occurrence or criterion fragment. For family F, the synthesis nextcheck often specifies only rebind/review; read the linked fragment scope and witness, and derive an executable affected-consumer check without inventing a receipt.
